about_the_game:
Dark Trip is fully playable without a VR headset. VR mode is supported and optional.

Psychedelic escape room where a player eats pills to solve puzzles

Dive into a haunting world filled with grotesque biotechnological machinery and the wicked remnants of dark experiments. Experience mind-bending psychedelic trips that distort perception and twist your surroundings.

Welcome to one of the most unique and bizarre gaming experiences, where you take on the role of an investigator searching for a missing woman — and are forced to consume drugs during your mission! The boundaries between reality and hallucinations dissolve, immersing you in a Lovecraftian nightmare when in a small German town, the only daughter of a retired businessman vanishes without a trace. 

Hired to investigate the case, the player discovers a seemingly abandoned laboratory. As you explore room after room, you uncover evidence of twisted experiments, scattered notebooks of employees, and disturbing accounts from test subjects. The gameplay revolves around solving intricate puzzles while piecing together the unsettling truth of the past.

Experience mind-bending psychedelic gameplay!

  • Solve Puzzles in an Eerie Environment. Dive into a haunting world filled with grotesque biotechnological machinery and the wicked remnants of dark experiments.

  • Experiences Psychedelic Trips. Immerse yourself into mind-bending psychedelic trips that distort perception and twist your surroundings. 

  • Use Hallucinations to Find Missing Evidence. Search for clues, artifacts and diary pieces to discover the dark story behind the gruesome events.

Enter the surreal horror!

content_descriptors.notes:
- Game's protagonist has to consume drug of unknown origin to discover gameplay objects that otherwise cannot be seen and found.
- The game setting involves sadomasochistic themes, some of the characters are dressed in bdsm outfits.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti/AMD Radeon RX 470 or greater
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus PC
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590/AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060/AMD Radeon RX 480 or greater
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus PC
